views.name: source_health
views.definition:
SELECT s.id,
    s.name,
    s.source_type,
    s.tier,
    s.enabled,
    s.poll_interval_minutes,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(s.consecutive_failures, 0) >= 5 THEN GREATEST(s.poll_interval_minutes, 60)
            WHEN COALESCE(s.consecutive_failures, 0) >= 3 THEN GREATEST(s.poll_interval_minutes, 45)
            WHEN COALESCE(s.consecutive_failures, 0) >= 1 THEN GREATEST(s.poll_interval_minutes, 30)
            ELSE s.poll_interval_minutes
        END AS effective_poll_interval_minutes,
    s.last_checked_at,
    s.last_success_at,
    s.last_error_at,
    s.consecutive_failures,
    cr.success AS last_run_success,
    cr.fetched_count AS last_fetched_count,
    cr.inserted_count AS last_inserted_count,
    cr.error_message AS last_run_error,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT s.enabled THEN 'disabled'::text
            WHEN s.last_checked_at IS NULL THEN 'never_checked'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(s.consecutive_failures, 0) >= 5 THEN 'hard_failed'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(s.consecutive_failures, 0) > 0 THEN 'degraded'::text
            WHEN cr.success IS TRUE AND COALESCE(cr.fetched_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'reachable_empty'::text
            WHEN cr.success IS TRUE THEN 'healthy'::text
            ELSE 'unknown'::text
        END AS health_status
   FROM sources s
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.success,
            r.fetched_count,
            r.inserted_count,
            r.error_message
           FROM crawl_runs r
          WHERE r.source_id = s.id
          ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) cr ON true;

views.name: source_health_report
views.definition:
SELECT s.id,
    s.name,
    s.tier,
    s.runtime_mode,
    s.poll_interval_minutes,
    s.last_success_at,
    s.consecutive_failures,
    count(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS checks_24h,
    count(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND c.success) AS successful_checks_24h,
    COALESCE(sum(c.fetched_count) FILTER (WHERE c.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND c.success), 0::bigint) AS fetched_24h,
        CASE
            WHEN count(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) >= 12 AND count(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) AND NOT c.success) = 0 AND COALESCE(sum(c.fetched_count) FILTER (WHERE c.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)), 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'review_for_promotion'::text
            ELSE 'collect_evidence'::text
        END AS recommendation
   FROM sources s
     LEFT JOIN crawl_runs c ON c.source_id = s.id AND c.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)
  GROUP BY s.id;

views.name: hypopg_hidden_indexes
views.definition:
SELECT h.indexid AS indexrelid,
    i.relname AS index_name,
    n.nspname AS schema_name,
    t.relname AS table_name,
    m.amname AS am_name,
    false AS is_hypo
   FROM hypopg_hidden_indexes() h(indexid)
     JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = h.indexid
     JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = h.indexid
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = i.relnamespace
     JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = x.indrelid
     JOIN pg_am m ON m.oid = i.relam
UNION ALL
 SELECT hl.indexrelid,
    hl.index_name,
    hl.schema_name,
    hl.table_name,
    hl.am_name,
    true AS is_hypo
   FROM hypopg_hidden_indexes() hi(indexid)
     JOIN hypopg_list_indexes hl ON hl.indexrelid = hi.indexid
  ORDER BY 2;

views.name: hypopg_list_indexes
views.definition:
SELECT h.indexrelid,
    h.indexname AS index_name,
    n.nspname AS schema_name,
    COALESCE(c.relname, '<dropped>'::name) AS table_name,
    am.amname AS am_name
   FROM hypopg() h(indexname, indexrelid, indrelid, innatts, indisunique, indkey, indcollation, indclass, indoption, indexprs, indpred, amid)
     LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = h.indrelid
     LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
     LEFT JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = h.amid;
